title: Deaddrop SCHC rules absent: /deaddrop not in rule registry, appendix, or vectors (spec 18.9)
description: Spec 12-apps.md 18.9: /deaddrop CoAP messages MUST use the project SCHC rule set; rules for path /deaddrop, content-format 112, and OSCORE options are pre-provisioned (appendix-schc.md and constants.toml); implementations MUST match test vector outputs for compressed packets. Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: rust/lichen-schc/src/rules.rs (rule set v3, 35 rules) has no /deaddrop or confessions rules (:223-233 generic CoAP fields only); spec/appendix-schc.md has zero /deaddrop mentions; constants.toml none; test/vectors/schc_compression.json none; C schc.h none. Suggested placement: rust/lichen-schc/src/rules.rs + spec/appendix-schc.md + test/vectors/ (new deaddrop SCHC vectors) + C rule tables. Refs R-12-077, R-12-078.
